name: woyofal-map
description: Woyofal Map - l'application qui aide les menages senegalais a maitriser leur electricite (FCFA, tranches Senelec).

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run env:init && npm run build:core && npm run db:setup
scripts.demarrer: npm run setup && npm run build && npm start
scripts.db:setup: npm run -w @woyofal/api db:push && npm run -w @woyofal/api db:seed
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && concurrently -n API,WEB -c green,cyan "npm run -w @woyofal/api dev" "npm run -w @woyofal/web dev"
scripts.build: npm run -w @woyofal/core build && npm run -w @woyofal/api build && npm run -w @woyofal/web build
scripts.mobile: npm run build:core && npm run -w @woyofal/mobile start
scripts.test: npm run -w @woyofal/core test && npm run -w @woyofal/api test
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w @woyofal/core typecheck && npm run -w @woyofal/api typecheck && npm run -w @woyofal/web typecheck && npm run -w @woyofal/mobile typecheck
